paragraphs.text: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are not ye my work in the Lord?
paragraphs.original: Οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐλεύθερος; οὐκ εἰμὶ ἀπόστολος; οὐχὶ Ἰησοῦν τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν ἑόρακα; οὐ τὸ ἔργον μου ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐν κυρίῳ;
paragraphs.translit: Ouk eimi eleutheros; ouk eimi apostolos; ouchi Iēsoun ton kyrion hēmōn heoraka; ou to ergon mou hymeis este en kyriō;

paragraphs.text: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.
paragraphs.original: εἰ ἄλλοις οὐκ εἰμὶ ἀπόστολος, ἀλλά γε ὑμῖν εἰμι, ἡ γὰρ σφραγίς μου τῆς ἀποστολῆς ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐν κυρίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: ei allois ouk eimi apostolos, alla ge hymin eimi, hē gar sphragis mou tēs apostolēs hymeis este en kyriō.

paragraphs.text: My defence to them that examine me is this.
paragraphs.original: Ἡ ἐμὴ ἀπολογία τοῖς ἐμὲ ἀνακρίνουσίν ἐστιν αὕτη.
paragraphs.translit: Hē emē apologia tois eme anakrinousin estin hautē.

paragraphs.text: Have we no right to eat and to drink?
paragraphs.original: μὴ οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν φαγεῖν καὶ πεῖν;
paragraphs.translit: mē ouk echomen exousian phagein kai pein;

paragraphs.text: Have we no right to lead about a wife that is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?
paragraphs.original: μὴ οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν ἀδελφὴν γυναῖκα περιάγειν, ὡς καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ τοῦ κυρίου καὶ Κηφᾶς;
paragraphs.translit: mē ouk echomen exousian adelphēn gynaika periagein, hōs kai hoi loipoi apostoloi kai hoi adelphoi tou kyriou kai Kēphas;

paragraphs.text: Or I only and Barnabas, have we not a right to forbear working?
paragraphs.original: ἢ μόνος ἐγὼ καὶ Βαρναβᾶς οὐκ ἔχομεν ἐξουσίαν μὴ ἐργάζεσθαι;
paragraphs.translit: ē monos egō kai Barnabas ouk echomen exousian mē ergazesthai;

paragraphs.text: What soldier ever serveth at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not the fruit thereof? Or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?
paragraphs.original: τίς στρατεύεται ἰδίοις ὀψωνίοις ποτέ; τίς φυτεύει ἀμπελῶνα καὶ τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐσθίει; τίς ποιμαίνει ποίμνην καὶ ἐκ τοῦ γάλακτος τῆς ποίμνης οὐκ ἐσθίει;
paragraphs.translit: tis strateuetai idiois opsōniois pote; tis phyteuei ampelōna kai ton karpon autou ouk esthiei; tis poimainei poimnēn kai ek tou galaktos tēs poimnēs ouk esthiei;

paragraphs.text: Do I speak these things after the manner of men? or saith not the law also the same?
paragraphs.original: Μὴ κατὰ ἄνθρωπον ταῦτα λαλῶ ἢ καὶ ὁ νόμος ταῦτα οὐ λέγει;
paragraphs.translit: Mē kata anthrōpon tauta lalō ē kai ho nomos tauta ou legei;

paragraphs.text: For it is written in the law of Moses, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn. Is it for the oxen that God careth,
paragraphs.original: ἐν γὰρ τῷ Μωϋσέως νόμῳ γέγραπται· Οὐ κημώσεις βοῦν ἀλοῶντα. μὴ τῶν βοῶν μέλει τῷ θεῷ,
paragraphs.translit: en gar tō Mōyseōs nomō gegraptai· Ou kēmōseis boun aloōnta. mē tōn boōn melei tō theō,

paragraphs.text: or saith he it assuredly for our sake? Yea, for our sake it was written: because he that ploweth ought to plow in hope, and he that thresheth, [to thresh] in hope of partaking.
paragraphs.original: ἢ διʼ ἡμᾶς πάντως λέγει; διʼ ἡμᾶς γὰρ ἐγράφη, ὅτι ὀφείλει ἐπʼ ἐλπίδι ὁ ἀροτριῶν ἀροτριᾶν, καὶ ὁ ἀλοῶν ἐπʼ ἐλπίδι τοῦ μετέχειν.
paragraphs.translit: ē diʼ hēmas pantōs legei; diʼ hēmas gar egraphē, hoti opheilei epʼ elpidi ho arotriōn arotrian, kai ho aloōn epʼ elpidi tou metechein.

paragraphs.text: If we sowed unto you spiritual things, is it a great matter if we shall reap your carnal things?
paragraphs.original: εἰ ἡμεῖς ὑμῖν τὰ πνευματικὰ ἐσπείραμεν, μέγα εἰ ἡμεῖς ὑμῶν τὰ σαρκικὰ θερίσομεν;
paragraphs.translit: ei hēmeis hymin ta pneumatika espeiramen, mega ei hēmeis hymōn ta sarkika therisomen;

paragraphs.text: If others partake of [this] right over you, do not we yet more? Nevertheless we did not use this right; but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the gospel of Christ.
paragraphs.original: εἰ ἄλλοι τῆς ὑμῶν ἐξουσίας μετέχουσιν, οὐ μᾶλλον ἡμεῖς; Ἀλλʼ οὐκ ἐχρησάμεθα τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ ταύτῃ, ἀλλὰ πάντα στέγομεν ἵνα μή τινα ἐγκοπὴν δῶμεν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ei alloi tēs hymōn exousias metechousin, ou mallon hēmeis; Allʼ ouk echrēsametha tē exousia tautē, alla panta stegomen hina mē tina enkopēn dōmen tō euangeliō tou Christou.

paragraphs.text: Know ye not that they that minister about sacred things eat [of] the things of the temple, [and] they that wait upon the altar have their portion with the altar?
paragraphs.original: οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ τὰ ἱερὰ ἐργαζόμενοι τὰ ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ ἐσθίουσιν, οἱ τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ παρεδρεύοντες τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ συμμερίζονται;
paragraphs.translit: ouk oidate hoti hoi ta hiera ergazomenoi ta ek tou hierou esthiousin, hoi tō thysiastēriō paredreuontes tō thysiastēriō symmerizontai;

paragraphs.text: Even so did the Lord ordain that they that proclaim the gospel should live of the gospel.
paragraphs.original: οὕτως καὶ ὁ κύριος διέταξεν τοῖς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον καταγγέλλουσιν ἐκ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ζῆν.
paragraphs.translit: houtōs kai ho kyrios dietaxen tois to euangelion katangellousin ek tou euangeliou zēn.

paragraphs.text: But I have used none of these things: and I write not these things that it may be so done in my case; for [it were] good for me rather to die, than that any man should make my glorifying void.
paragraphs.original: Ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ κέχρημαι οὐδενὶ τούτων. οὐκ ἔγραψα δὲ ταῦτα ἵνα οὕτως γένηται ἐν ἐμοί, καλὸν γάρ μοι μᾶλλον ἀποθανεῖν ἤ— τὸ καύχημά μου οὐδεὶς κενώσει.
paragraphs.translit: Egō de ou kechrēmai oudeni toutōn. ouk egrapsa de tauta hina houtōs genētai en emoi, kalon gar moi mallon apothanein ē— to kauchēma mou oudeis kenōsei.

paragraphs.text: For if I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of; for necessity is laid upon me; for woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel.
paragraphs.original: ἐὰν γὰρ εὐαγγελίζωμαι, οὐκ ἔστιν μοι καύχημα, ἀνάγκη γάρ μοι ἐπίκειται· οὐαὶ γάρ μοί ἐστιν ἐὰν μὴ εὐαγγελίσωμαι.
paragraphs.translit: ean gar euangelizōmai, ouk estin moi kauchēma, anankē gar moi epikeitai· ouai gar moi estin ean mē euangelisōmai.

paragraphs.text: For if I do this of mine own will, I have a reward: but if not of mine own will, I have a stewardship intrusted to me.
paragraphs.original: εἰ γὰρ ἑκὼν τοῦτο πράσσω, μισθὸν ἔχω· εἰ δὲ ἄκων, οἰκονομίαν πεπίστευμαι.
paragraphs.translit: ei gar hekōn touto prassō, misthon echō· ei de akōn, oikonomian pepisteumai.

paragraphs.text: What then is my reward? That, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel without charge, so as not to use to the full my right in the gospel.
paragraphs.original: τίς οὖν μού ἐστιν ὁ μισθός; ἵνα εὐαγγελιζόμενος ἀδάπανον θήσω τὸ εὐαγγέλιον, εἰς τὸ μὴ καταχρήσασθαι τῇ ἐξουσίᾳ μου ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: tis oun mou estin ho misthos; hina euangelizomenos adapanon thēsō to euangelion, eis to mē katachrēsasthai tē exousia mou en tō euangeliō.

paragraphs.text: For though I was free from all [men,] I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.
paragraphs.original: Ἐλεύθερος γὰρ ὢν ἐκ πάντων πᾶσιν ἐμαυτὸν ἐδούλωσα, ἵνα τοὺς πλείονας κερδήσω·
paragraphs.translit: Eleutheros gar ōn ek pantōn pasin emauton edoulōsa, hina tous pleionas kerdēsō·

paragraphs.text: And to the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, not being myself under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐγενόμην τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὡς Ἰουδαῖος, ἵνα Ἰουδαίους κερδήσω· τοῖς ὑπὸ νόμον ὡς ὑπὸ νόμον, μὴ ὢν αὐτὸς ὑπὸ νόμον, ἵνα τοὺς ὑπὸ νόμον κερδήσω·
paragraphs.translit: kai egenomēn tois Ioudaiois hōs Ioudaios, hina Ioudaious kerdēsō· tois hypo nomon hōs hypo nomon, mē ōn autos hypo nomon, hina tous hypo nomon kerdēsō·

paragraphs.text: to them that are without law, as without law, not being without law to God, but under law to Christ, that I might gain them that are without law.
paragraphs.original: τοῖς ἀνόμοις ὡς ἄνομος, μὴ ὢν ἄνομος θεοῦ ἀλλʼ ἔννομος Χριστοῦ, ἵνα κερδάνω τοὺς ἀνόμους·
paragraphs.translit: tois anomois hōs anomos, mē ōn anomos theou allʼ ennomos Christou, hina kerdanō tous anomous·

paragraphs.text: To the weak I became weak, that I might gain the weak: I am become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.
paragraphs.original: ἐγενόμην τοῖς ἀσθενέσιν ἀσθενής, ἵνα τοὺς ἀσθενεῖς κερδήσω· τοῖς πᾶσιν γέγονα πάντα, ἵνα πάντως τινὰς σώσω.
paragraphs.translit: egenomēn tois asthenesin asthenēs, hina tous astheneis kerdēsō· tois pasin gegona panta, hina pantōs tinas sōsō.

paragraphs.text: And I do all things for the gospel`s sake, that I may be a joint partaker thereof.
paragraphs.original: πάντα δὲ ποιῶ διὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον, ἵνα συγκοινωνὸς αὐτοῦ γένωμαι.
paragraphs.translit: panta de poiō dia to euangelion, hina synkoinōnos autou genōmai.

paragraphs.text: Know ye not that they that run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? Even so run; that ye may attain.
paragraphs.original: Οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι οἱ ἐν σταδίῳ τρέχοντες πάντες μὲν τρέχουσιν, εἷς δὲ λαμβάνει τὸ βραβεῖον; οὕτως τρέχετε ἵνα καταλάβητε.
paragraphs.translit: Ouk oidate hoti hoi en stadiō trechontes pantes men trechousin, heis de lambanei to brabeion; houtōs trechete hina katalabēte.

paragraphs.text: And every man that striveth in the games exerciseth self-control in all things. Now they [do it] to receive a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
paragraphs.original: πᾶς δὲ ὁ ἀγωνιζόμενος πάντα ἐγκρατεύεται, ἐκεῖνοι μὲν οὖν ἵνα φθαρτὸν στέφανον λάβωσιν, ἡμεῖς δὲ ἄφθαρτον.
paragraphs.translit: pas de ho agōnizomenos panta enkrateuetai, ekeinoi men oun hina phtharton stephanon labōsin, hēmeis de aphtharton.

paragraphs.text: I therefore so run, as not uncertainly; so fight I, as not beating the air:
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ τοίνυν οὕτως τρέχω ὡς οὐκ ἀδήλως, οὕτως πυκτεύω ὡς οὐκ ἀέρα δέρων·
paragraphs.translit: egō toinyn houtōs trechō hōs ouk adēlōs, houtōs pykteuō hōs ouk aera derōn·

paragraphs.text: but I buffet my body, and bring it into bondage: lest by any means, after that I have preached to others, I myself should be rejected.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ ὑπωπιάζω μου τὸ σῶμα καὶ δουλαγωγῶ, μή πως ἄλλοις κηρύξας αὐτὸς ἀδόκιμος γένωμαι.
paragraphs.translit: alla hypōpiazō mou to sōma kai doulagōgō, mē pōs allois kēryxas autos adokimos genōmai.
